client.name: Halo Beverages
client.profile: Mid-size sparkling drinks brand. ~600 employees, USD 220M revenue. Sells to supermarket chains (FreshMart, Northgate Grocers), convenience-store distributors (QuickStop Distribution), and an online marketplace. SAP ECC live since 2011.
client.project: ECC to S/4HANA migration, discovery phase

steps.name: Receive order
steps.plain: Orders arrive by EDI from chains, by portal from distributors, by feed from the marketplace.

steps.name: Price the order
steps.plain: The system prices each line, applies discounts, and decides whether someone has to approve.

steps.name: Check customer credit
steps.plain: Is the customer allowed to buy this much on account?

steps.name: Confirm delivery date and stock
steps.plain: Can we ship what they asked for, when they asked for it?

steps.name: Invoice the customer
steps.plain: The invoice is created and sent.

steps.name: Collect payment and handle deductions
steps.plain: Payment comes in, short-pays and chargebacks are resolved.

node_fields.label: Automatic trade discount for supermarket chains
node_fields.system_value: 8% off list price, applied automatically to every order from customer group 'Chains'
node_fields.plain: Every chain order gets 8% off before anyone touches it.

derived_from.line: Discount D-01, Chain trade discount, 8%. Set by Jo Hoffman at the 2011 go-live. Applies to all six products on chain orders.

node_fields.label: Manual discount that triggers manager approval
node_fields.system_value: Reps can enter a manual discount up to 20%. Approval workflow to the sales manager triggers only when the manual discount exceeds 15%.
node_fields.plain: A rep can give up to 15% extra without anyone being asked. Between 15% and 20% the order waits for the sales manager.

derived_from.line: Discounts D-02 and D-03: a 20% cap on what a rep can type, and approval above 15%. The cap was set at go-live; the 15% approval rule was set by Marco Ferreira in 2019.

node_fields.label: Stacking a promotion discount on top of the volume discount
node_fields.system_value: No exclusion configured. Promotion discount (up to 12%) and volume discount (3% to 6%) both apply on the same line when both are valid.
node_fields.plain: If a product is on promotion and the order is large, the customer gets both discounts added together.

derived_from.line: Discounts D-04 (Citrus promotion, 12%, set by Sam Okafor) and D-05 (volume, 3 to 6%, set at go-live) both apply to the Citrus products. Nothing in the tables says one excludes the other.

node_fields.label: Free goods on the Classic range
node_fields.system_value: Buy 10 cases of any Classic-range product, get 1 case free. Active since 2016-04-02, created by user MBRANDT (left the company in 2020). Applies to all customer groups.
node_fields.plain: The system adds a free case for every 10 cases of Classic ordered, for every customer, and has done since 2016.

derived_from.line: Discount D-06, Classic free case, 1 free per 10. Set by Martin Brandt in 2016, who left in 2020. Applies to both Classic products for every customer, no end date.

node_fields.label: How long a negotiated chain price list stays valid
node_fields.system_value: Chain price lists are valid 12 months from creation. After expiry the line falls back to list price minus the 8% trade discount.
node_fields.plain: A negotiated price for a chain quietly expires after a year unless someone renews it.

derived_from.line: Product table: Northgate's negotiated prices on Classic Cola and Citrus Sparkle were valid until 31 Jul 2025. Lena Park maintains them. Nothing renews them automatically.

node_fields.label: Discounts on marketplace orders
node_fields.system_value: Manual discounts not allowed for customer group 'Marketplace'. Upper limit 0%.
node_fields.plain: Nobody can discount a marketplace order. The price is the price.

derived_from.line: Discount D-07, Marketplace discount, 0%. Set by Lena Park in 2018. No manual discount is possible on marketplace orders.

connections.carries: order lines with customer, products, quantities
net order value after discounts (credit exposure)
free-goods quantities added to the pick list
final line prices and discounts printed on the invoice
invoice amount; disputes over promo pricing arrive here as short-pays

node.why_this_node: Pricing is where the client's commercial rules live. It feeds credit exposure, the pick list (free goods), the invoice, and most short-pay disputes.
